title: Closing address to the Constituent Assembly

access.edition_or_version: Delivered 25 November 1949, two days before adoption of the Constitution; verified via the Constituent Assembly record

tone_mechanisms_observed: naming a freedom the citizen already holds: constitutional guarantees framed as freedoms owned rather than privileges granted
constitutional moral warrant, including the warning against the 'grammar of anarchy'
direct address to a present 'we' at close psychic distance and high certainty
mechanics.language_note: English-language Indian text, alongside Annihilation of Caste (dossier section E).
